meta.promptText: India mein women ke liye online konse brand ke kurta sets kharidun?

response.text:

In sabka style aur price range alag hai, isliye aapko apne budget aur occasion ke hisaab se choose karna easy hoga. Recent fashion comparisons mein bhi in brands ko comfort, fabric, fit aur styling ke liye compare kiya gaya hai.
